parts.text:

parts.text:
Measure, and record in Table 1.1, the distance x from the centre of P to the zero end of
the ruler. Record the weight P.

parts.text:

metre ruler does not change.

parts.text:
Plot a graph of P/ N (y-axis) against x/ cm (x-axis).
Draw the best-fit line.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Use the graph to find the value of x required to balance the ruler when P = 3.5 N.
Show clearly on the graph how you determined the value of x.
x = ______ cm
